analogy.rationale: TRPV1 is a sensory-neuron ion channel that these cell lines (melanoma, lung, kidney, liver, colon, breast, prostate) express little or not at all, so TRPV antagonists should produce essentially no transcriptional response; the closest listed classes are other TRPV/cannabinoid/neuropeptide receptor ligands that also act on poorly expressed neuronal receptors.
